meta.title: Pricing — {price} per screen per month
meta.description: One price, everything included: {price} per screen per month. {trialDays}-day free trial, no credit card, no contract. Digital signage software that scales from one screen to a thousand.

hero.title: Published pricing.
hero.subtitle: {price} per screen, per month, with every feature switched on — up to five screens. Above five, the price is quoted for the size of your network.
hero.note: No credit card to start. We invoice monthly.

items.a: No. You pay monthly and stop whenever you want. Nothing is tied to a twelve-month commitment, and there is no cancellation fee. If you stop paying, your screens keep showing the last content they downloaded until you take them down.

items.q: Do I need a credit card to start the trial?
items.a: No. You create an account, pair a screen and use everything for {trialDays} days. There is no card to enter at any point — if you continue, the first invoice arrives after the trial.
The trial simply stops. Your content and settings stay in the account, so if you come back a month later everything is where you left it. Screens stop syncing new content until you subscribe.

items.q: Can I run just one screen?
items.a: Yes, and plenty of customers do — a bakery, a salon, a waiting room. One screen is {price} a month, and nothing about the product is switched off at the low end.

You move to Enterprise: the same product, with a price quoted for the size of your network rather than taken off this page. Tell us how many screens you run and we will send a number — there is nothing to unlock and no feature waiting behind it.

items.q: What is not included in the price?
items.a: The hardware. You need a screen and a small player device — an Android box, a mini-PC or a computer you already have. We do not resell hardware, so you buy it wherever it is cheapest for you.
No. Invite as many people from your team as you like; you pay for screens, not seats.

items.q: Can I pause over a quiet season?
items.a: Yes. Remove the screens you are not using and the bill drops the same month. Add them back when the season turns and your content is still there.
Everything is priced in euros, and there is no card to enter — we do not run a payment gateway. You get an invoice each month and pay it by bank transfer, on the terms your finance team works with.

There is a {trialDays}-day free trial rather than a permanently free tier. We would rather keep every feature switched on for everyone during the trial than run a free plan with a watermark on your screen.

plans.title: Two ways to buy
plans.subtitle: The same product either way — the number of screens decides which one you are on.
plans.billing: Monthly invoice, paid by bank transfer. No card details, no payment gateway.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.body: Tell us how many screens you run and we will send a price, usually within one business day.
included: Everything in Basic — the product is identical
